exit_methodology.source: src/session_sweep_continuation/outcome_resolution.py -- canonical terminal states: RESOLVED_SL, RESOLVED_SESSION_EXIT, RESOLVED_PARTIAL_BE, RESOLVED_PARTIAL_RUNNER_TARGET, AMBIGUOUS_SEQUENCE, UNRESOLVED_NO_DATA. Unmodified by this pilot.
exit_methodology.ambiguous_sequence_handling: Occurrences resolving to AMBIGUOUS_SEQUENCE are excluded from the metric population and counted separately under exclusions.ambiguous -- never silently dropped, never assigned an assumed outcome (see resolved_vs_unresolved_occurrences below)

resolved_vs_unresolved_occurrences.resolved: terminal_state in {RESOLVED_SL, RESOLVED_SESSION_EXIT, RESOLVED_PARTIAL_BE, RESOLVED_PARTIAL_RUNNER_TARGET} with a non-null gross_R -- included in metric population
resolved_vs_unresolved_occurrences.excluded_not_unresolved: AMBIGUOUS_SEQUENCE (a bar touching SL and TP ambiguously) and terminal_state with gross_R is None are excluded from the metric population and reported in exclusions -- these are DIFFERENT from 'occurrence still open at data end' (this DEVELOPMENT run has a bounded, fully-elapsed interval, so no occurrence should be open at data end; any such case would surface via UNRESOLVED_NO_DATA and must be reported explicitly, not silently folded into the resolved population)

metric_formulas.source: src/performance/calculator.py:compute_trade_metrics -- frozen, canonical, reused unmodified (same function used by GEN_001 and every other SSC performance report in this repository)
metric_formulas.net_expectancy_R: sum(net_R for resolved occurrences) / N, or NOT_EVALUATED if any net_R is None
metric_formulas.profit_factor: sum(gross_R for gross_R>0) / abs(sum(gross_R for gross_R<0)); UNDEFINED_NO_LOSSES if no losses; UNDEFINED_NO_WINS if no wins -- never a synthetic large number or infinity, consistent with SSC1D_WP1A_economic_floor_contract.json's zero-loss handling for the (separate) OOS floor
metric_formulas.max_drawdown_R: peak-to-trough on cumulative gross_R over samples ordered by (resolved_at, source_record_id) -- deterministic ordering, ties broken by immutable source_record_id
metric_formulas.average_win_R_average_loss_R: mean of gross_R within WIN / LOSS classes respectively (classification: gross_R > 1e-9 = WIN, gross_R < -1e-9 = LOSS, else BREAKEVEN)
metric_formulas.min_sample_size_convention: strategies/ST_SESSION_SWEEP_CONTINUATION_V1.yaml performance_attribution.min_sample_size=10 -- any decomposition group below this must be flagged low-sample, per existing SSC convention, not treated as a confident PASS/FAIL signal

mae_mfe_availability: NOT independently recomputed by this baseline run's own driver script (the canonical replay/outcome_resolution pipeline used here does not itself emit per-trade MAE/MFE). Where MAE_R/MFE_R evidence exists for this exact population, it is sourced read-only from artifacts/research/EXP_EXPOSURE_EFFICIENCY_V1/GEN_001/per_trade_results.csv's CONTROL rows -- justified only if this run's population_hash is independently confirmed identical to GEN_001's (see reproducibility below); if the hashes do not match, MAE/MFE must be reported NOT_AVAILABLE for this baseline rather than borrowed from a non-identical population.
